title: docs(components): spell the inherited `disabled` as `boolean | string`
body:
Fixes #7239

The docs half of the #7087 ruling (maintainer, 2026-09-01, option 1 scoped to `disabled`). That ruling removed the 18 `disabled?: boolean` narrowings from the concrete schemas, so the member is now inherited from `BaseSchema` as `boolean | string` — a boolean, or a predicate expression on the same evaluated path as `visible`. 13 component pages went on spelling the removed narrowing in their illustrative interfaces, teaching a type the shipped tree no longer has. A reader copying those rows would conclude that `disabled: "${data.status === 'locked'}"` is invalid, which is exactly the capability the ruling restored.

## Premise re-verified on the base, not taken from the card

Base `ebc05b4d6`. Every one of the 22 `disabled?:` rows under `content/docs/components` was attributed to its **enclosing interface** by walking back to the nearest declaration, rather than trusting the card's table — the table turned out to be exactly right, including the two files that carry one in-scope and one out-of-scope row each:

| population | rows | disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| schemas inheriting `disabled` from `BaseSchema` | 13 | corrected to `boolean | string` |
| `basic/button-group.mdx` (`ButtonGroupSchema`) | 1 | already correct (#6347); the spelling the other 13 converged on |
| independent item/option shapes | 8 | left at plain `boolean` |

All 13 in-scope interfaces were confirmed to `extends BaseSchema` with no `disabled` of their own on this base, and all remaining `disabled?: boolean` declarations in `packages/types/src` were confirmed to belong to independent shapes (`ListItem`, `AccordionItem`, `ToggleGroupItem`, `SelectOptionMetadata`, `SelectOption`, `RadioOption`, `FormField`, `ComboboxOption`, `TabItem`, `NavLink`, `ButtonGroupButton`, `MenuCommandItem`) — so the narrowings really are gone and the pages really were the stale side.

## Why a pin instead of a gate turning red-then-green

No gate can see this drift, and that was measured rather than assumed: `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` compiles only the fence languages in its own `TS_FENCE_LANGUAGES` set (line 317: `ts`, `tsx`, `typescript`), and all 14 rows in question live in `plaintext` fences (13) or a `text` fence (1). `check-doc-component-types` reads only the `type` string literals. So a member row in those fences may name any type at all and every gate stays green — the hole #6143 records.

The new pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-docs-disabled-inherited-7239.test.ts` (44 cases) therefore carries the invariant:

1. **Inherited (14 rows)** — the page's `disabled` row reads `boolean | string`, **and** the shipped interface of the same name still extends `BaseSchema` without redeclaring `disabled`. The second half is what keeps the pin honest in the other direction: a future re-narrowing fails pointing at `packages/types`, not at the page, because in that world the page would be the thing that is right.
2. **Independent (8 rows)** — the item/option shapes still read exactly `boolean`. This is the blanket-replace control: a sweep that rewrote every `disabled?: boolean` under `content/docs/components` turns these red.
3. **Completeness** — the two tables account for **every** `disabled?:` row under `content/docs/components` by measurement, so a new page carrying the stale spelling fails here instead of sitting unclassified.

Boundary stated in the file rather than implied: the three overlay menu-item rows are doc-local names with no shipped counterpart (`ContextMenuCommandItem` / `DropdownMenuCommandItem` / `MenubarCommandItem` against a shipped `MenuCommandItem`), so only their doc text is asserted.

## Bounded in-place fix, named with evidence

`packages/types/src/__tests__/button-group-doc-surface-6347.test.ts` header said *13 of those 14 component schemas REDECLARE `disabled?: boolean` themselves … so their pages are right*. After #7087 that sentence is false in both halves. The paragraph is rewritten to mark the 13-of-14 reading as history and point at the new pin. **Comment text only** — mechanically confirmed: `git diff -U0` on that file, with comment lines filtered out, is empty, and the file's assertions stay green in the run below (it is one of the 87 files in the `packages/types` suite).

It qualifies as a bounded in-place fix on all four counts: same defect class as the card (a stale `disabled?: boolean` reading left behind by #7087), mechanical with the correct shape pinned by the landed ruling, no other claim holds that file, and no new verification surface (it is already covered by the `packages/types` suite).

## Ablation — mutation and restore both proven on disk

The pin resolves nothing through any package `dist/` (it imports only `vitest` and `node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:url` and reads source files off disk), so no rebuild is involved in either leg; the mutations were confirmed by anchored text counts, not by an editor's exit code.

| leg | mutation proven on disk | pin result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| all 13 pages reverted to their base blobs | `wide_union_rows=0`, `bare_boolean_rows=15` | **13 failed / 31 passed** — each naming its own page; `ButtonGroupSchema` and all 8 independent rows stayed green |
| `form/select.mdx` alone narrowed | `injected_bare=1`, `removed_wide=0` | **1 failed / 43 passed** — `Expected: "form/select.mdx SelectSchema -> boolean \| string"` / `Received: "... -> boolean"` |
| `form/form.mdx` `FormField` alone widened (blanket-replace control) | `injected_wide=1`, `removed_bare=0` | **1 failed / 43 passed** — `Expected: "form/form.mdx FormField -> boolean"` / `Received: "... -> boolean \| string"` |

Those results match the predictions written into the pin's header before the first run. Every restore leg used `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` under a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths, and was proven by blob hash rather than by an exit code: 13/13 and 2/2 disk hashes equal to their `HEAD` blobs, none empty, with `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status --porcelain` clean afterwards.

## Verification — union run at `dd802b688` on a clean tree

| check | verdict line |
| --- | --- |
| the new pin | `Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 44 passed (44)` |
| `packages/types` suite | `Test Files 87 passed (87)` / `Tests 1221 passed (1221)` |
| `@object-ui/types` `type-check` | exit 0, all three projects; `--listFiles` on `tsconfig.test.json` confirms both touched test files are in the 543-file compiled set (`tsconfig.json` excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so this was checked rather than assumed) |
| `check:doc-fences` | `✅ check:doc-fences — every TypeScript block in 224 document(s) is fenced ts/tsx/typescript …` |
| `check:doc-types` | `✅ Every documented component type is registered.` |
| `docs:check-links` | `Links are valid across 17 scan roots.` |
| `check:control-bytes` | `✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 6026 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `check:docs-route-closure` | `✅ MEASURED_PAYLOAD is honest …` |
| `check-changeset-presence` | `✅ 2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s) …` |
| `check-changeset-no-major` | `✅ No changeset declares a `major` bump.` |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` | `✅ NOT GOVERNED — 16 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.` |

**Declared narrowing — `check:doc-snippets` was not run locally.** It exits **2**, which its own output defines as `PRECONDITION NOT MET … This is "I could not run", NOT "I ran and found errors" (exit 1)`: it needs a 25-package build first. The narrowing is backed by measurement, not convenience: (1) the population comes from the gate's own `TS_FENCE_LANGUAGES` set rather than a guess about which files count; (2) 0 of the 14 changed doc rows are in that population — 13 sit in `plaintext` fences, 1 in a `text` fence; (3) the diff adds and removes no fence and changes no fence language (`check:doc-fences` green), and the other two changed files are a comment-only test edit and a new test, neither of which is a document, so the gate's verdict on untouched files cannot move. CI runs it regardless.

A changeset **is** owed and is included with **empty frontmatter** (declaring that nothing releases) — the two touched files under `packages/types/src/` are published source, so the presence gate asks; its own text calls the empty-frontmatter form "a pass, not a workaround", and there is precedent in `.changeset/theme-schema-doc-rewrite-5648.md`.

Staying **draft** for the PM to land. `#7087` remains closed by its own PR and is only referenced here; nothing in this PR changes `packages/types` source or `content/docs/releases/`.
